dz: 新闻自由:"纽约周刊"作家约翰·彼得·赞格(John Peter Zenger)被宣告无罪,罪名是煽动对纽约皇家总督的诽谤,理由是他所发表的是真实的.
de: Freedom of the press: New York Weekly Journal writer John Peter Zenger is acquitted of seditious libel against the royal governor of New York, on the basis that what he had published was true.
